name: claude-quenching
description: OKF-centric knowledge-base aligner for the Claude Code surface of any repository. Installs one canonical Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.1) docs/ bundle, forces existing docs into conformance, inserts knowledge into the right home, curates a fixed A–Z glossary, drains project memory into docs, refactors CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md into thin pointers, imports external sources as OKF docs, renders the bundle as a self-contained offline HTML diagram, and loops it all to convergence. Ten skills (the routing story lives in each skill's own description) plus a self-contained validation hook and a zero-dependency HTML diagram generator. Every repository that adopts it looks the same.
